legend: Bone marrow smear in a case with MECOM rearrangement with increased cellularity showing some myeloid blasts, erythroid dysplasia, and (especially) several dysplastic megakaryocytes with non-lobed or bilobed nuclei (Giemsa).

Bone marrow core biopsy showing hypercellular bone marrow with a diffuse infiltrate of myeloid blasts. Increased eosinophils are conspicuous and atypical; mononuclear megakaryocytes are present (<<39583>>). This case is characterized by prominent reticulin fibrosis (<<39584>>).

diagnosis: Acute myeloid leukaemia (AML) with MECOM rearrangement from inv(3)(q21.3q26.2) or t(3;3)(q21.3;q26.2)
legend: The paracentric inversion results from the breakage and rejoining of bands 3q21 and 3q26.2 within one chromosome 3; G-banded normal chromosome 3 is shown on the left of each pair of homologues, and the points of rearrangement on each derivative chromosome 3 from the inversion are indicated by arrows (<<40760>>). The translocation results from the breakage and rejoining of bands 3q21 and 3q26.2 between chromosome 3 homologues; G-banded derivative chromosome 3 is shown for each pair of homologues, with the points of rearrangement indicated by arrows. (<<40761>>). Dual-colour dual-fusion FISH strategy with probes for GATA2 (3q21.3) and MECOM (3q26.2); representative interphase nucleus with abnormal close proximity of GATA2 and MECOM resulting in a dual-fusion signal pattern (arrows): one green signal for normal GATA2, one red signal for normal MECOM, and two fusion signals for GATA2 proximal to MECOM indicating a chromosome 3 inversion. A normal nucleus is also present (two green signals for the normal GATA2 region and two red signals for normal MECOM). Images of individual nuclei were merged from the same case (<<40766>>).
